title: Canonical site comparison of the independently normalized affine-line counit
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a coefficient level n, a Noetherian scheme T on which l is invertible, and r with l^(r+1) annihilating the finite coefficient ring A, canonical compact-support site comparison followed by comparison of the ordinary affine-line counit on every bounded-below ordinary coefficient K equals the independently defined supported-Kummer pro-etale lineCounit. The source comparison is exactly lineSiteComparison, not a chosen comparison; no finite-type field hypothesis is imposed. Use [def-pur-proetale-ordered-integration] [def-amb-affine-trace-construction] [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates].

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3, restricted projective-line counit and induction along ordered coordinates. Site comparison of these named counits is agent-written, using Stacks proetale.tex Tags 099R and 09AF and categories.tex Tag 0B65.

proof.text: CartierKummerChern identifies the supported Chern arrow with comparison of the normalized ordinary Chern arrow: identify the root-normalized Tate isomorphisms and use the scalar Kummer class of the infinity divisor, whose divisor line is O(1). The direct-image counit mate and inverse-image comparison carry the twisted-unit and Chern adjuncts to projectiveU and projectiveH. Compare on the two biproduct injections, then invert the decompositions and take the second projection to compare traces.

The coefficient-first proper projection square commutes with canonical tensor and pullback comparison, including the two symmetry maps. Combine its inverse with the trace comparison and the right unitor. The resulting compared ordinary projective counit satisfies ProperIntegrationEquation, hence equals projectiveEpsilon by its uniqueness.

The extension comparison is the adjoint mate of restriction comparison. Transpose the open counit square under the exact open adjunction: both sides become the identity with that restriction comparison. Descend the equation to derived categories. Compose with the projective counit equation; naturality of the proper mate gives the lineSiteComparison source identification and the lineCounit equation. No finite-type-over-field assumption enters the proper/open comparisons, so arbitrary Noetherian bases, zero rings, and the empty base are included.

Generic adjunction uniqueness and composite-counit equations, in particular Adjunction.comp_counit_app; no site or Kummer-normalized trace theorem.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Reuse generic composition identities; named normalized comparison is absent.

mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib hits. Project rg finds the finite-type-over-field AffineTowerIntegrationSiteTransport and P1KummerTraceSiteTransport; they do not apply to arbitrary Noetherian T. VectorIntegrationSiteComparison has downstream circular imports. Blueprint searches for ordered affine trace, affine tower, and counit comparison found no matching imported node.
mathlib_searches.verdict: A separate all-Noetherian counit comparison is needed.

from.place: Every map involved was normalized by the Kummer generator; normalized vector-bundle integration at the normal-bundle endpoint. The affine-coordinate comparison is the independent part before vector-bundle gluing.

lean.statement:
theorem lineCounit_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ) (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ)
    (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)))) :
    lineCounit l E n T hT (infinityCartier T) r hA K =
      (lineSiteComparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) T
        ⟨_, rightTower_plus l E n T hT r hA 1 K⟩).hom ≫
      (comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) T).map
        ((Etale.affineTraceLineAdjunction _ (l ^ (r + 1)) hA
          (Etale.projectiveLineTraceTransport _ (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) _ hA)
          T (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hT.pow (r + 1))
          (Etale.projectiveLineTraceDatum _ (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) _ hA
            T (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hT.pow (r + 1)))).counit.app K.obj)
